'''Rocket Warehouse''', also known as Team Rocket Warehouse, is one of the last refuge of Team Rocket, located in the meadow of [[Chrono Island]].

There is a static encounter with a Klinklang in the back room.

==Trivia==
[[File:StuckRocketWarehouse.png|thumb]]
During the grunts sound the Alarm, it is possible they corner the player. Interacting with the defeated Grunts will then cause them to run away.

There is a scene between Team Rocket and Team Plasma happening in the Executive's office.
